name: FORGE
tagline: Build the sales leader your market needs.
audience: Sales leaders, revenue executives, client-facing professionals in B2B and professional services
delivery_format: 36-question self-assessment, instant report, optional consultant debrief
outcome_statement: A clear picture of your sales capability profile across four dimensions, with your primary sales archetype and a personalized development roadmap to grow into the next level of sales leadership.
use_cases: Self-assessment for sales professionals seeking to understand their capability profile
Sales team capability audit and development planning
Pre-hire assessment for senior sales roles
Identifying strengths and growth areas for revenue professionals

scoring_framework.method: Four-dimension profile with archetype mapping via 2×2 matrix logic
scoring_framework.archetype_detection: Highest-scoring archetype based on dimension weighting and fit scoring
scoring_framework.response_scale: 5-point Likert — Strongly Disagree to Strongly Agree

dimensions.name: Adaptive Learning Orientation
dimensions.description: How quickly you learn from sales experiences, adapt your approach, and incorporate feedback and market signals into your practice.

dimensions.name: Market Context Awareness
dimensions.description: How well you understand the broader market, competitive, organizational, and client context that shapes sales outcomes.

dimensions.name: Development Agency
dimensions.description: The degree to which you proactively drive your own sales development, seek growth opportunities, and take ownership of your capability building.

dimensions.name: Bilateral Relationship Quality
dimensions.description: How effectively you build and maintain mutual-value client relationships that go beyond transactional selling.

archetypes.name: Rainmaker
archetypes.summary: Natural closer with strong client relationships and adaptive learning — the classic high-performing sales leader.
archetypes.growth_area: Market context depth — can underestimate structural factors

archetypes.name: System Builder
archetypes.summary: Process-driven sales professional who builds scalable systems and development frameworks.
archetypes.growth_area: Frontline closing instinct — can over-rely on process

archetypes.name: Strategic Seller
archetypes.summary: Market-savvy seller with strong context awareness and relationship quality — thrives in complex enterprise deals.
archetypes.strengths: Complex deal navigation, client advisory, strategic thinking
archetypes.growth_area: Development proactivity — may wait for opportunities instead of creating them

archetypes.name: Promoted Seller
archetypes.summary: Strong individual performer who has moved into leadership but still operates from an individual contributor mindset.
archetypes.strengths: Individual results, personal drive, quick learning
archetypes.growth_area: Team enablement and relationship leverage — needs to shift from doing to enabling

pillar_mapping.relationship: FORGE is the 'human capability' counterpart to SPARK's AI readiness — sales leaders need both AI literacy and core sales excellence
cross_pillar_relevance: P1 Talent Pipeline Health — sales leadership is a key pipeline segment

key_methodological_notes: 36 questions total, 9 per dimension — balanced design
Four archetypes map to different combinations of dimension strengths
Report includes archetype profile, dimension breakdown, and development roadmap
